title: scene-server: opt-in conditional with invitedUserIds mark
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9g. Crates: jmap-scene-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §7; conditional-02 §9.1; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_scene_conditional; register_scene_handlers unchanged; SceneRegion/get marks per-caller-blanked invitedUserIds with with_unreadable; memory on ScopedState + ConditionalBackend; Atomic final-state: one avatar per region, region nesting, quotas. Acceptance: invitedUserIds precondition by a non-permitted caller -> forbidden; atomic rollback; final-state test; public-api additions only.
